title: Product Manager II - Retail Tax, Transactions, and Performance
searchText: Product Manager II - Retail Tax, Transactions, and Performance Coinbase Careers Page Ready to be pushed beyond what you think you’re capable of? At Coinbase, our mission is to increase economic freedom in the world. It’s a massive, ambitious opportunity that demands the best of us, every day, as we build the emerging onchain platform — and with it, the future global financial system. To achieve our mission, we’re seeking a very specific candidate. We want someone who is passionate about our mission and who believes in the power of crypto and blockchain technology to update the financial system. We want someone who is eager to leave their mark on the world, who relishes the pressure and privilege of working with high caliber colleagues, and who actively seeks feedback to keep leveling up. We want someone who will run towards, not away from, solving the company’s hardest problems. Our work culture is intense and isn’t for everyone. But if you want to build the future alongside others who excel in their disciplines and expect the same from you, there’s no better place to be. While many roles at Coinbase are remote-first, we are not remote-only. In-person participation is required throughout the year. Team and company-wide offsites are held multiple times annually to foster collaboration, connection, and alignment. Attendance is expected and fully supported. Our Consumer Trade team is looking for a Product Manager to play a pivotal role in helping our users understand and manage their crypto taxes, portfolio performance, and realized / unrealized gains and losses across their Coinbase activity and beyond. You will lead the ideation, development, and execution of a best‑in‑class retail tax experience and tax center that simplifies an incredibly complex problem space—multiple wallets, on‑chain transfers, gas fees, and incomplete cost basis—while ensuring Coinbase can meet its tax reporting obligations in key markets. You will also own core parts of the consumer trading experience visited by millions of users every month, including transaction history and performance. You will leverage your understanding of financial transactions, tax concepts, and trading performance to build engaging, trustworthy experiences that help users manage their transactions, P&L, and tax obligations in one place. What you’ll be doing Own the Retail Tax, Transactions, and Performance roadmap : Understand user behaviors, emerging tax regulations, and market trends to conceptualize and implement a roadmap that makes it dramatically easier for customers to view their transactions, track their performance, and handle their crypto taxes (including handling use cases like multiple wallets, on‑chain transfers, and gas fees). Data‑driven decision making : Define success metrics and run experiments to evaluate the effectiveness of tax and performance experiences (e.g., completeness of tax profiles, reduction in missing cost basis, engagement with tax tools, downstream filing behavior). Use data and user feedback to continuously iterate and improve. Ship from 0→1 and 1→N : Own product development from conception to launch and beyond, iterating until you’ve created the most seamless, trusted retail tax and performance experience in crypto. Design for scale and seasonality : Ensure the Retail Tax and performance surfaces are reliable, performant, and intuitive during critical periods such as tax season and major market events. Align teams on a shared vision : Drive clarity and alignment across Consumer Trade and partner teams on the Retail Tax and performance vision, requirements, and execution plan, and keep everyone focused on the highest‑impact problems. What we look for in you 5+ years of product management experience, including time spent building or scaling consumer products, ideally in fintech, investing, tax, or other data‑heavy domains. Domain expertise in financial transactions and taxes, such as experience with tax reporting products, cost basis, gains/loss calculations, or evaluating trading performance. Strong analytical and data skills, with experience working on P&L, performance analytics, or similar financial reporting surfaces for retail users. Consumer UX experience and a strong product/design sense for presenting complex financial information in simple, understandable, and engaging ways. Experience building 0→1 products in high‑ambiguity spaces, creatively solving problems under constraints while maintaining a high quality bar. Ability to work with complex stakeholder sets, including Tax, Legal, Compliance, Finance, support, and external partners, and to balance regulatory, business, and user needs. Crypto literacy and hands‑on exposure to crypto products—ideally including on‑chain activity such as DEX trading or send/receive flows—so you can deeply understand the pain points of tax in a multi‑wallet, multi‑chain world. Excellent communication and influence skills, with a track record of shaping strategic decisions and driving alignment across senior stakeholders. An entrepreneurial mindset and ability to succeed in a fast‑paced, evolving environment. Aptitude for learning and the ability to quickly ramp on new and complex regulatory and technical domains. Nice to haves Direct experience with US tax reporting rules for digital assets (e.g., cost basis, 1099 reporting, wash sales, staking rewards). Job# P75681 #LI-Remote Pay Transparency Notice: Depending on your work location, the target annual base salary for this position can range as detailed below. Total compensation may also include equity and bonus eligibility and benefits (including medical, dental, vision and 401(k)). Annual base salary range (excluding equity and bonus): $180,370 — $212,200 USD Please be advised that each candidate may submit a maximum of four applications within any 30-day period. We encourage you to carefully evaluate how your skills and interests align with Coinbase's roles before applying. Commitment to Equal Opportunity Coinbase is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, creed, gender, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, sex, gender expression or identity, sexual orientation or any other basis protected by applicable law. Coinbase will also consider for employment qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with applicable federal, state and local law. For US applicants, you may view the Employee Rights and the Know Your Rights notices by clicking on their corresponding links. Additionally, Coinbase participates in the E-Verify program in certain locations, as required by law. Coinbase is also committed to providing reasonable accommodations to individuals with disabilities. If you need a reasonable accommodation because of a disability for any part of the employment process, please contact us at accommodations[at]coinbase.com to let us know the nature of your request and your contact information. For quick access to screen reading technology compatible with this site click here to download a free compatible screen reader (free step by step tutorial can be found here) . Global Data Privacy Notice for Job Candidates and Applicants Depending on your location, the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) and California Consumer Privacy Act (CCPA) may regulate the way we manage the data of job applicants. Our full notice outlining how data will be processed as part of the application procedure for applicable locations is available here . By submitting your application, you are agreeing to our use and processing of your data as required. For US applicants only, by submitting your application you are agreeing to arbitration of disputes as outlined here. AI Disclosure For select roles, Coinbase is piloting an AI tool based on machine learning technologies to conduct initial screening interviews to qualified applicants. The tool simulates realistic interview scenarios and engages in dynamic conversation. A human recruiter will review your interview responses, provided in the form of a voice recording and/or transcript, to assess them against the qualifications and characteristics outlined in the job description. For select roles, Coinbase is also piloting an AI interview intelligence platform to transcribe and summarize interview notes, allowing our interviewers to fully focus on you as the candidate. The above pilots are for testing purposes and Coinbase will not use AI to make decisions impacting employment . To request a reasonable accommodation due to disability, please contact accommodations[at]coinbase.com Ready to be pushed beyond what you think you’re capable of?
